## Goal

Explore the processed dataset and answer the reporting question.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

raw_dir <- here("input", "raw")
processed_dir <- here("input", "processed")
output_dir <- here("output")
```

## Load

```{r}
df <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(processed_dir, "population_communes_2024_clean.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Explore

```{r}
dplyr::glimpse(df)
dim(df)

df |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "share_missing") |>
  arrange(desc(share_missing))

df |> count(region, sort = TRUE)

df |>
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    minimum = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
